name: X: Screenshot
summary: Capture one X post, reply, or longform article as a tightly cropped PNG.
description: Open a public or authenticated X URL, find the requested post/reply or longform article, and save a PNG clipped to that content element. The image is intentionally unstyled for downstream processing.

url.description: Full x.com or twitter.com status/article URL.

mode.description: Force post/reply or longform article targeting. Auto uses the URL and rendered DOM.

inputs.script: const inputUrl=String(arg0||location.href);const forced=String(arg1||'auto').toLowerCase();const inputPath=(()=>{try{return new URL(inputUrl).pathname}catch{return location.pathname}})();const id=(inputPath.match(/\/(?:status|article)\/(\d+)/i)||[])[1]||'';const articleMode=forced==='article'||(forced==='auto'&&/\/article\//i.test(inputPath));const visible=(el)=>{if(!el)return false;const r=el.getBoundingClientRect(),s=getComputedStyle(el);return r.width>0&&r.height>0&&s.display!=='none'&&s.visibility!=='hidden'};let target=null;if(!articleMode){const posts=[...document.querySelectorAll("main article[data-testid='tweet'], main article[role='article'], main article")].filter(visible);target=posts.find((post)=>[...post.querySelectorAll("a[href*='/status/']")].some((a)=>new RegExp('/status/'+id+'(?:$|[/?#])').test(a.getAttribute('href')||'')))||posts[0]||null;document.querySelectorAll("button[data-testid='tweet-text-show-more-link'], [role='button'][data-testid='tweet-text-show-more-link']").forEach((button)=>{if(target?.contains(button))button.click()});}else{const roots=[document.querySelector('main article'),document.querySelector('main section[role=region]'),document.querySelector('main')].filter(visible);target=roots.sort((a,b)=>(b.querySelectorAll('p').length*100+(b.textContent||'').length)-(a.querySelectorAll('p').length*100+(a.textContent||'').length))[0]||null;}if(!target)throw new Error('Could not find the requested X '+(articleMode?'article':'post/reply'));document.querySelectorAll('[data-rzn-screenshot-target]').forEach((el)=>el.removeAttribute('data-rzn-screenshot-target'));target.setAttribute('data-rzn-screenshot-target','true');target.scrollIntoView({block:'start'});if(!articleMode)window.scrollBy(0,-64);await new Promise((resolve)=>setTimeout(resolve,500));if(document.fonts?.ready)await document.fonts.ready;await Promise.all([...target.querySelectorAll('img')].map((img)=>img.complete?null:img.decode().catch(()=>null)));const rect=target.getBoundingClientRect();return{kind:articleMode?'article':'post',url:location.href,requested_url:inputUrl,x:Math.round(rect.x),y:Math.round(rect.y),width:Math.round(rect.width),height:Math.round(rect.height)};

steps.name: Identify the exact post, reply, or article

help.summary: Capture one X post, reply, or longform article as a tightly cropped PNG.

parameters.url: Full x.com or twitter.com status/article URL.
parameters.mode: auto | post | article. Replies use post mode.

examples.description: Capture the requested post or reply.

examples.command: rzn-browser run x screenshot --param url="https://x.com/user/article/123" --param mode=article
examples.description: Capture the entire rendered longform article.

returns: Content metadata plus artifacts.screenshots[0].path for the PNG.
notes: Read-only. Uses the connected Chrome profile, so authenticated and public posts both work.
The PNG is clipped to the rendered content element; no rounded corners, padding, shadows, or other downstream styling is applied.
Replies are captured through the same post path by matching the requested status id.
